leaves.text: CONDITION: Poor cooling performance in a vehicle with a dual (front/rear) A/C system. The system uses a joint type expansion valve* in the rear cooling unit, with no magnetic valve. The compressor has been confirmed to be ok, and the front expansion valve was replaced recently.

leaves.text: CAUSE: The thermosensitive tube of the rear expansion valve has become loose and is not reading the evaporator outlet temperature accurately. This caused the expansion valve to open more than necessary, and caused more refrigerant to flow to the rear cooling unit.

leaves.text: With a design that's easy for people to interact with and a small body that's easy to carry so that it can be taken anywhere, COBOTTA is a collaborative robot that can automate work immediately.
Do you need that extra hand? Do you want to leave simple tasks to robots, and make more time for creative work?
This flyer introduces options that are engineered to work with COBOTTA to meet needs like those by expanding the range of possible uses for the robot.

Two types of hand tools are available*1. You can also fabricate your own hand tool for use with COBOTTA.
This hand tool is ideal for the basic operations of gripping and releasing.
This tool makes it easy to pick up items via suction, without providing an external air compressor.

By attaching a camera designed specifically for use with COBOTTA to the robot's wrist, you can perform work while detecting the position of target objects. Use the factory default calibration to get up and running right away with no troublesome initial setup process.
This AF camera sets the optimal exposure automatically and eliminates the need to focus manually.
This base plate allows COBOTTA to operate in a freestanding orientation without being mounted. The base plate is divided into two parts, upper side and lower side.
This cable allows to connect an external monitor to COBOTTA via a standard, commercially available VGA cable.
This data cable connects COBOTTA to an external device.

leaves.text: WINCAPS Plus is a software package that provides the optimal application according to the environment used and the customer, and simplifies everything from robot introduction to design and maintenance.

By embedding commands such as flow control statements (conditional branching) in the robot's path, programming can be performed while visually grasping the robot's movement, making it easy for users who are not familiar with programming language to program.

By specifying the start and end points of the robot's motion, the system will automatically generate a path that avoids obstacles and has the shortest cycle time. The robot's path design, which used to rely on the experience of the user, can be generated scientifically so that both skilled and novice users can operate the robot with the same performance.

Assuming that the path taken by the robot during automatic operation is safe, with no obstacles, the system generates a path that allows the robot to safely return to the origin from the operation path that was automatically collected.
*If you are using RC8, a separate dedicated IPC is required.

Robot Viewer is a 3D viewer that can be used with WINCAPS Plus. It provides a comfortable simulation environment for the WINCAPS Plus product line with enhanced 3D CAD data loading, an object operation environment, and object management.

This software is used in the palletizing/depalletizing process. The shape and dimensions of pallets and loads on the software are input, then automatic calculation is performed and the target position is displayed considering the movable range.
